C1 commentary · 100 words
## param-p01-v01 — C1 **SUMMARY.** I resort to all-abiding Śambhu. The sorrow-wheel-whirled student asks the supreme truth; the teacher answers in support-verses, retold Śaiva-wise. The Lord manifests the fourfold egg by power-weight; the embodied enjoyer is Śiva fettered. As crystal takes colors the Lord holds all forms; as moon moves with water the self moves with the world. As Rahu shows on the moon the everywhere-self shows in the mind-mirror; grace-purified mind mirrors the light-formed self, replete with will, knowing and acting. *Rasa: bhakti-śānta of refuge and teaching — Opening refuge (bhakti) settling into taught peace (śānta): invoked, asked, answered.*
source → · scholar notes →

C1 commentary · 107 words
## param-p02-v11 — C1 **SUMMARY.** The supreme principle, free of thought, pure and at peace, shines the thirty-six-fold world as towns shine in a mirror — undivided yet divided, lit by the five powers in divided nature. Supreme freedom effects what is hard; Māyā-power veils Śiva's self. Grasped knowing stains and the person turns beast, sixfold fettered; the atom knows but little here and now, six-sheathed within. As husk on rice, separate yet one, purity comes by the Śiva path; mere pleasure-pain-delusion proceeds from resolve into the ordered inner organ. *Rasa: śānta of taught order — Doctrinal enumeration settling into peace: tattvas, organs, elements told in order.*
source → · scholar notes →

C1 commentary · 95 words
## param-p03-v20 — C1 **SUMMARY.** Ear to nose know, voice to privates do; their objects are subtle and division-free tanmātras, whose mixture grossifies into five elements. Creation from nature husks consciousness down to earth; three sheaths wrap the self. Through ignorance-darkness the one self perceives manifold grasper-grasped variety — as one cane-juice in many sweets, all states of Śambhu. Knower, ruler, breath and the rest are mere convention; rope-snake fear kills, and delusion's power none can tell apart. *Rasa: śānta of taught order — Doctrinal enumeration settling into peace: tattvas, organs, elements told in order.*
source → · scholar notes →

## param-p04-v29 — C1 **SUMMARY.** So dharma through pain, caste through stations, though unreal in the self, arise by delusion's force. This is that darkness: shining in things, the not-self is taken for self — darkness upon darkness, a burst upon the cheek, body and breath taken for self. By body-breath-reflection yoga the self wraps itself in a net like the net-maker; unwrapped by its own shining glory, supreme Śiva spreads the play of bondage and release. Creating, waking, sleep shine in the fourth, yet unveiled. Waking is difference-universe, dreaming is light-glory, sleep is massed knowing — beyond, the fourth. As sky unsoiled by cloud-smoke-dust, the person untouched by Māyā; as one dusty jar leaves others clean, souls enjoy differences unstained. *Rasa: karuṇa-śānta of bondage shown and dissolved — Darkness pitied, unwrapping stillness: net shown, play spread, gold seen.*
